changes.rationale: Route the task-page loop through commands and add a ticket skill, without adding a gate. cargo xtask task-artifact next reads the task record, the pages and a per-task reviews.json and prints the one next step (record, author, review, rewrite, best, commit, build, complete); it exits 3 when it also has advice, such as a page edited after its last verdict, and never blocks. task-artifact verdict appends a review row (page, round, pass|revise|best, the page's LF SHA-256, reviewer, notes), keeps the reviewed version under target/, and refuses re-reviews of the same version, a fourth review and a misplaced best; the artifact author's hook refuses edits to reviews.json. Completion does not read the log. The stop hook, on a branch stacked on another remote branch, takes its base from where this branch's own commits start, so a lower unmerged PR's records and page order are left to that PR; HARNESS_BASE still overrides it and PR CI is unchanged. A write-ticket skill for Claude Code and Codex turns a request into a ticket and a partial task record stub. Skills stay ceremony paths: the requested carve-out was dropped because skill frontmatter can register hooks and grant tools. Limits: next cannot see an order breach before completion, Bash writes to the log are unconfined, and a copy of the branch pushed under another name hides its commits from the stop hook.
